Siege is a mixed multi-upstream collection; its separate quarantine bucket is not an independent source family. Partial imports cannot collapse unrelated original authors into one original lineage, nor create a new vote.

All Wikimedia teaching pages/authors/assets count as one conservative acquired family. Shared general guitar pedagogy between KU and Wikimedia is a possible residual dependence, not evidence of a proven common copied database.
Unacquired manual teaching sources (Dirk Laukens, Berklee, Fender and others) are source leads; they add zero empirical votes until lawful, row-level acquisition and lineage verification.
